mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing citalopram plasma concentrations; both agents may have additive antiplatelet/anticoagulant effects.
action: Monitor for increased citalopram side effects (QT prolongation, serotonin syndrome signs); counsel on bleeding precautions; consider dose adjustment if using high-dose turmeric supplements.
